013/**
014 * A version of {@link Gamepad} with {@link Trigger} factories for command-based.
015 *
016 * <p>This class is provided by the Commands v2 VendorDep
017 *
018 * @see Gamepad
019 */
020@SuppressWarnings("MethodName")
021public class CommandGamepad {
022  private final CommandGenericHID m_hid;
023  private final Gamepad m_gamepad;
024
025  /**
026   * Construct an instance of a controller.
027   *
028   * @param port The port index on the Driver Station that the controller is plugged into.
029   */
030  public CommandGamepad(int port) {
031    m_hid = CommandGenericHID.getCommandGenericHID(port);
032    m_gamepad = DriverStation.getGamepad(port);
033  }
034
035  /**
036   * Construct an instance of a controller with a Gamepad object.
037   *
038   * @param gamepad The Gamepad object to use for this controller.
039   */
040  public CommandGamepad(Gamepad gamepad) {
041    m_gamepad = Objects.requireNonNull(gamepad, "Provided gamepad cannot be null");
042    m_hid = new CommandGenericHID(m_gamepad.getHID());
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Get the underlying CommandGenericHID object.
047   *
048   * @return the wrapped CommandGenericHID object
049   */
050  public CommandGenericHID getHID() {
051    return m_hid;
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Get the underlying Gamepad object.
056   *
057   * @return the wrapped Gamepad object
058   */
059  public Gamepad getGamepad() {
060    return m_gamepad;
061  }
062

681  /**
682   * Constructs a Trigger instance around the axis value of the left trigger. The returned trigger
683   * will be true when the axis value is greater than {@code threshold}.
684   *
685   * @param threshold the minimum axis value for the returned {@link Trigger} to be true. This value
686   *     should be in the range [0, 1] where 0 is the unpressed state of the axis.
687   * @param loop the event loop instance to attach the Trigger to.

689   *     threshold, attached to the given event loop

691  public Trigger leftTrigger(double threshold, EventLoop loop) {
692    return axisGreaterThan(Gamepad.Axis.LEFT_TRIGGER, threshold, loop);
693  }
